notes: Processing, shelf-life, logistics and channel mix come from general knowledge of Hormel; the website evidence does not cover them.

food_beverage_category.value: Branded protein and packaged foods: pepperoni, bacon, deli and refrigerated meats, peanut butter, nuts, Mexican foods, sauces, snacks and meals

brand_private_label_manufacturing.value: Owned consumer brands, many leading in their categories, such as SKIPPY, PLANTERS, Applegate and HERDEZ

shelf_life_storage_condition.value: Mix of shelf-stable products (canned meats, peanut butter, nuts, salsas) and refrigerated meats

processing_technology.value: Meat processing, curing, smoking, cooking and slicing, plus canning and shelf-stable packaging

temperature_controlled_logistics.value: Chilled production and distribution for refrigerated meats, alongside ambient distribution of shelf-stable goods

customer_channel_sales_mix.value: Mainly grocery retail, with a sizable foodservice business and growing international sales

input_food_safety_exposure.value: Exposure to hog and pork prices and to other commodity inputs such as turkey, peanuts and grains; meat food-safety and recall risk
